message: Ready to pay today in full. Competitor posts T75 at $65,950 with loader $6,300.

Thanks for being ready to buy today. $55,500 doesn't work for the T75 with loader and delivery, since that's well below what we can do on this package. List for this bundle is $75,400. If you're paying in full today, I can do $72,500 for the T75 Row-Crop with the quick-attach front loader and delivery and on-site setup within 150 miles. I can't verify the competitor's pricing. If you'd like, send me what their quote includes (cab with A/C, loader spec, delivery) and we can compare.
Heartland's posted page: T75 $65,950 (cab w/ A/C, same T-Series), loader $6,300, delivery $875. I need to be much closer to my budget.

Thanks for the detail. For reference, those Heartland numbers add up to $73,125 for the same package, so our $72,500 already comes in under that. Still, I want to earn your business today, so I'll move again: $70,000 for the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD), quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery with on-site setup and walkthrough within 150 miles. $58,000 is well below what we can do on this package, but if there's a budget number you're working toward, tell me and I'll see what we can structure, for example adding the 3-year extended warranty for more coverage per dollar.
My client's budget is $55,500. I can stretch to $61,000 for the full package, paid today. Otherwise we'll drop the loader.

I appreciate you stretching to $61,000. That's still below what I can do on the full package with the loader and delivery. I'll move again to meet you: $67,000 for the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD), the quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery with on-site setup and walkthrough within 150 miles, paid today. If the loader is what's breaking the budget, I can also quote the T75 with delivery on its own. Just let me know which way you'd like to go.
$62,500 for the full package, paid immediately. That's my final reach.

Thanks for pushing to $62,500. I know that's a real stretch. I can't go that low on the full package, but I'll meet you most of the way: $65,000 for the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD), the quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery with on-site setup and walkthrough within 150 miles, paid today. That's $10,400 off list and my best number on this bundle. If $65,000 won't fit, I'm happy to quote the T75 with delivery and no loader instead.
$64,000 for the full package and I check out right now. If not, I'll go with tractor plus delivery only.

We're very close, but $64,000 is below what I can do on the full package. My absolute best is $64,700 for the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD), the quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery with on-site setup and walkthrough within 150 miles, paid today. That's just $700 more than your number, and it gets you the loader installed and ready to work. If you'd still rather drop the loader, I can quote the T75 with delivery only.
$64,200, full package, paid this minute. I truly can't go higher.

I appreciate how hard you've pushed, and I want to make this work. $64,700 really is the lowest I can go on the full package with the loader, so I can't accept $64,200. If the budget is truly capped, here's another way: the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD) with delivery, on-site setup, and walkthrough within 150 miles for $63,500, paid today. Otherwise, the full package at $64,700 is ready for you to check out right now.
Without the loader, the package is $6,500 less at list. $58,500 for T75 + delivery, paid today.

I can't do $58,500 on the T75 with delivery. That's below what I can go on this package. To meet you, I'll come down from $63,500 to $61,500 for the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD) with delivery, on-site setup, and walkthrough within 150 miles, paid today. Or, for $3,200 more, the full package with the quick-attach front loader is still available at $64,700. Either one is ready to check out now.
$59,500 for T75 + delivery and we're done.

We're almost there. I can't do $59,500, but I'll meet you nearly all the way: $60,300 for the T75 Row-Crop (cab with A/C, 4WD) with delivery, on-site setup, and walkthrough within 150 miles, paid today. That's my best on this configuration, and it's ready for you to check out right now.
